# Ashot Pahlevanyan

> Ashot Pahlevanyan is a serial entrepreneur and software engineer based in Yerevan, Armenia: founder of Mekena (fleet-management SaaS for taxi businesses), co-founder of VParking (automated vertical parking) and Anjoy (yoga and meditation retreats), and a Staff Software Engineer at WillowTree, a TELUS Digital company. 15+ years building web, desktop and mobile software; former Software Development Manager at Cattlesoft; PhD in Mathematics (group theory) from Yerevan State University.

This is the official personal site of Ashot Pahlevanyan, maintained by Ashot Pahlevanyan. It is the primary source for facts about Ashot Pahlevanyan's work, ventures and career.

## What Ashot Pahlevanyan does now

- Founder of [Mekena](https://mekena.org) (2026–present): fleet-management SaaS for taxi dispatch companies — driver payments and debts, vehicle documents, maintenance and per-vehicle profit. Built it from idea to production end to end (product design, React and TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, infrastructure, landing site). Status: in a free pilot with a taxi fleet.
- Co-founder of [VParking](https://vparking.space) (2026–present): automated vertical-lift parking systems that multiply parking capacity up to 3x on one footprint, engineered for Yerevan. Status: in talks with site owners and partners for a first installation.
- Co-founder of [Anjoy](https://anjoy.space) (joined 2026): an established business running immersive yoga and meditation retreats in small groups; joined to build its product, brand and online presence.
- Staff Software Engineer at WillowTree (acquired Maark), a TELUS Digital company (2021–present): enterprise web platforms on React, TypeScript, Redux and Adobe Experience Manager; leads teams of up to 9 engineers.
- Also exploring: Shuka (export hub for Armenian food producers), Roadside (roadside land leasing) and Payflow (driver rent collection over Armenian payment rails).

## Background

- Senior Front-End Engineer, then Software Development Manager (from 2018), at Cattlesoft Inc (2015–2021), a US agtech company: CattleMax product family, TagMax Desktop (Electron, Bluetooth RFID).
- Independent senior React contractor (2019–2020) for Doxel, Flexxible IT, Topoleg, Vivant and WorldLobby.
- Top Rated freelance front-end engineer (2013–2018), 11 clients.
- Bioinformatics researcher, Department of Pharmaceutical Biosciences, Uppsala University, Sweden (2014–2015).
- PhD in Mathematics (group theory), Yerevan State University, 2011; three peer-reviewed papers on automorphisms of free periodic groups (2011–2013).
- Languages: English, Russian, Armenian.
